newsitem.title: USA: Engelhard forms joint venture in India.
newsitem.headline: Engelhard forms joint venture in India.

text.p: Engelhard Corp said on Thursday it formed a joint venture with UCAL Fuel Systems Ltd for the manufacture and sale of automotive-emission catalysts in India.
The joint venture plans to build a manufacturing plant 20 kilometers south of Madras.
Engelhard said it owns 70 percent of the new company, called Engelhard Environmental Systems (India) Ltd, while UCAL owns the remaining 30 percent.

Since 1995, catalytic converters have been required on new passenger vehicles sold in India's four major cities. By the year 2000, India is expected to enforce more stringent European emission standards, the company said.
About 150,000 auto catalysts were sold in India in 1996. Engelhard said the market is expected to exceed 500,000 units by 2000 and growing to over one million units by 2005.
